title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: goodwill waiver limits by product
content:
## Scope

This comparison sets out the commercial goodwill limits of each product in the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category: the largest waiver as a percentage, the largest waiver in money, the number of goodwill waivers a customer may receive in a trailing year, and the request window.

## Limits per product

| Product | Largest waiver (percent of the invoice amount still open after credits) | Largest waiver per invoice | Goodwill waivers per customer in the trailing 365 days | Request window (calendar days from the invoice date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 0 | USD 0.00 | 0 | 30 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 10 | USD 250.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 10 | USD 350.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 15 | USD 500.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 15 | USD 750.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 25 | USD 1500.00 | 4 | 60 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Largest waiver, percent**: the largest goodwill waiver as a whole percentage of the invoice amount still open after credits.
- **Largest waiver per invoice**: the largest goodwill waiver per invoice in money, in USD.
- **Waivers per trailing 365 days**: the number of goodwill waivers per customer in the trailing 365 days.
- **Request window**: the calendar days from the invoice date within which a goodwill waiver may be requested.

## Points of judgement

**Q: What are the percentage and money limits under AHL Combined Free Time 21?**
A: 15 percent and USD 750.00 per invoice.

**Q: How long after the invoice date may a customer on AHL Contract Free Time 30 ask for goodwill?**
A: Within 60 calendar days of the invoice date.

**Q: What limits does AHL Tariff Free Time carry?**
A: A percentage limit of 0, a money limit of USD 0.00 and a trailing-year allowance of 0 waivers.
